patch_description: I am replacing the complex, over-parameterized ansatz (which had 74 parameters and was overfitting) with a simpler two-bank (0-3, 4-7) sharing scheme. This scheme uses 6 parameters per block (RY_a, RY_b, RZ_pre_a, RZ_pre_b, RZ_post_a, RZ_post_b) for a total of 38 parameters. This architecture has previously demonstrated excellent generalization (gap ~0.00) and stability, and is designed to improve the test/validation accuracy by reducing the model's capacity for overfitting while maintaining sufficient expressivity.
